description: Invite one person, by email, to read and write one namespace prefix of THIS account (for example project:barn). Creates a pending grant and emails them; nothing is shared until they accept with list_invites and accept_invite from their own account. Calling again for the same person and prefix returns the existing invitation without a second email. Withdraw with revoke_grant(grant_id). Not available from a shared workspace session. Their first 30 days of Collaborator time are free; after that you can pay their $19 per 30 days from /account. You are emailed when they accept, and list_workspaces shows whether they have entered yet. Docs: https://ctxstore.ai/docs.html#verify-invitations

namespace_prefix.description: Key prefix to share, e.g. 'project:barn'. No wildcards.

note.description: Optional short note shown verbatim in the email (max 1000 chars).

name: invite
title: Invite Someone to a Namespace
